relations.text: データセンター向け発電にガスを供給する提携
relations.text_en: Partner to supply gas for new power generation for data centers

source.label: Comstock Resources 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We are partnering with NextEra Energy Resources, LLC ("NextEra") to provide natural gas for new power generation in Western Haynesville to support hyperscaler data center development with initial capacity of 2 gigawatts and potential expansion to 8 gigawatts.

source.label: Comstock Resources 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Comstock entered into an agreement with an affiliate of Quantum Capital Solutions ("Quantum"), in 2023 to form Pinnacle Gas Services, LLC ("PGS"), a midstream company in Comstock's Western Haynesville area.
